purpose: Authorize one exact-profile custom RTX LiDAR creation and complete-scan diagnostic before returning to the frozen Cano sensor smoke.

approval.scope: Use one deterministic analytic closed-box test scene, one local OmniLidar USDA carrying the unchanged 16x720/10 Hz/0.3-50 m profile, one sensor, one pose, and exactly one saved complete RTX scan. No Cano world, formal dataset, training, M-TARE, built-in sensor, CPU backend, profile change, or automatic 24-pose rerun.
approval.confirmation_reference: User message after the exact purpose, counts, method, baseline, no-fallback rule, evidence, and stop boundary were presented: 你现在要推进的任务是什么一定明白你的目的不是为了做而做继续做吧

source.license_or_allowed_use: The analytic box and local USDA are project-authored diagnostic assets; no Cano, benchmark, or third-party world is used.

sampling.selection_rule: Place one sensor deterministically at the center of a fixed six-wall analytic box; save only the first complete scan and stop.
sampling.sensor_contract: Isaac Sim 6.0.1 RTX Lidar Core loaded only with Lidar.create(usd_path=...), 16 emitters and channels, channel IDs 1-16, elevations -15 to +15 degrees in 2-degree steps, 720 ticks per revolution from 7200/10 Hz, 0.3-50 m, one return, idealized rays, no angular or range error.
sampling.label_contract: No topology or semantic label is generated; this probe validates only sensor creation, parameter identity, SensorChecker acceptance, and one complete GMO scan.

evidence.machine_metrics: Preserve the local USDA/hash, exact attribute read-back and mismatch list, SensorChecker result and validated parameter count, GMO header/shape/return counts, full diagnostic NPZ, command, image identity, logs, summary and evidence hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Render the only saved 16x720 range image with physical axes, range units, run ID, exact scope and claim boundary; there is no sample selection.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on schema, attribute, checker, GMO, shape, nonzero-return, hash, image or evidence failure. Do not modify the profile, use a built-in LiDAR, use CPU output, change the scene, retry with another method, or resume the 24-pose smoke.

estimated_cost.compute: One short headless RTX GPU process in the pinned Isaac Sim 6.0.1 image, followed by one offline range-image rendering; network disabled and no dependency installation.
